title: Write a personalized children's storybook with agents
summary: A student built SparkStory, where six agents fact-check a parent's story idea, outline it, wait for parent approval, then write, illustrate and narrate the book.
agent_role: Agents research the premise for factual mistakes, draft and self-review an outline, then write and check the prose, with optional pictures and narration. The parent describes the child and must approve or revise the outline before any writing starts.
outcome: The instructor reports the project is working and open source; no usage numbers are given.
what_they_did: Maryam Tabatabaie built SparkStory as a course capstone. A parent describes their child's age, interests and a story idea. Six specialized agents check the idea for factual errors, draft an outline and improve it in a review loop. The parent approves the outline, then agents write and check the story.
how_it_went: Her instructor shared it as an open-source project that can also create illustrations and narrate the finished story. No results from real families are reported.
worth_knowing: The system refuses to write prose until a parent approves the outline, and it rejects outlines that drift from the original brief.
prompt: Help me write a personalized children's story for my [age]-year-old who loves [interests]. Story idea: [your idea]. First, check the idea for any factual mistakes a child might learn wrongly and list them. Then draft a short outline, review it yourself against my brief, and improve it. Show me the outline and wait for my approval or changes before writing anything. Once I approve, write the story in simple language for that age, then check the prose for readability and consistency with the outline. Finally, suggest a short description for an illustration on each page.

curation.rationale: An open-source multi-agent system with a clear step-by-step workflow and parent approval built in, a fresh non-coding use; but it is a course capstone shared by the instructor with a course plug and no reported results from real families.
